name: Caffeine & Alcohol Curfew
equipment: None -- just a plan for the day
instructions: Keep caffeine to the morning and early afternoon today -- its effects can linger for 6+ hours.
If you drink alcohol, know that while it can make you feel drowsy, it fragments sleep later in the night and reduces deep sleep.
Swap an evening drink for herbal tea or water if you'd normally have one close to bedtime.
Close the day with tonight's wind-down meditation.
